instruction.name: vsle.wu
instruction.description: Compare the unsigned 32-bit elements in `a` and `b`, store all-ones to `dst` if corresponding element in `a` is less than or equal to `b`, zero otherwise.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vsle.wu $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vsle.wu $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vsle.wu $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vsle.wu $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vsle.wu $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vsle.wu $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vsle.wu $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vsle.wu $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
